stories.title: Golden State advances to face Atlanta in the WNBA Finals, beating Las Vegas 87-77 in overtime for a series sweep

en.title: Golden State advances to face Atlanta in the WNBA Finals, beating Las Vegas 87-77 in overtime for a series sweep
en.summary: The Golden State Valkyries defeated the Las Vegas Aces 87-77 in overtime during Game 3 of the WNBA semifinals, completing a series sweep and advancing to the Finals to face Atlanta.

stories.title: Informal support can help youth mental health — before they’re in crisis

en.title: Informal support can help youth mental health — before they're in crisis
en.summary: Free training from Jack.org educates parents, teachers, and friends on how to provide early support to young people facing mental health challenges before situations escalate.

stories.title: At least 36 people hurt after shopping mall ceiling collapses in South Korea’s Daegu city

en.title: At least 36 people hurt after shopping mall ceiling collapses in South Korea's Daegu city
en.summary: A plaster ceiling partially collapsed at a shopping mall in Daegu, South Korea, resulting in at least 36 people sustaining minor injuries, according to fire officials.

en.title: NHL roundup: Capitals beat Rangers 3-1, Shesterkin exits injured in second period
en.summary: The Washington Capitals defeated the New York Rangers 3-1 in an NHL game, with Rangers goaltender Shesterkin leaving the match with an injury during the second period.

en.title: Isaac Brown brings Louisville back from the brink as Cardinals pummel Florida State 44-20
en.summary: Louisville defeated Florida State 44-20 in an NCAA college football game. Quarterback Lincoln Kienholz led the Cardinals' comeback performance against the Seminoles.

en.title: Winnipeg Jets suffer first regulation loss of season, falling 5-1 to Anaheim
en.summary: The Winnipeg Jets lost 5-1 to Anaheim in regulation, marking their first loss of the season. Kyle Connor scored for Winnipeg but could not prevent the defeat.
